description: This dataset describes laboratory-designed organic fractions of municipal solid waste for energy-recovery analysis. The research collaborators provide recipes for food, green and paper waste, followed by dry and organic dry matter, carbon, hydrogen and nitrogen measurements. Further groups report calorific values, ash melting, anaerobic-digestion methane yields and food-waste storage experiments. Coverage concerns designed laboratory mixtures in Germany; it does not establish the composition of a municipal collection stream or a common calendar observation period. Mendeley version 1 describes five file groups and states CC BY 4.0 with free access. The public API returned 502, so file formats and current inventories remain unknown despite readable repository-page and DOI metadata. Laboratory formulation and storage conditions are limitations for plant-scale simulation. data-nigeria-kenya-south-africa-organic-waste-feedstocks provides related composition evidence, while platform-brightway-lca supports separate assessment. No experimental table, sample or model was downloaded or analysed.
